body:
Here’s the Q:

 Searching high and low for the theological commentary and approach you mentioned in your book “We Make the Road by Walking” on page xxii footnote #8.  I’m expecting to use this as a resource to guide our worship for the next year, beginning September 2017.  Can you direct me or send to me the resource?

 Here’s the R:

 So sorry this has been hard to find. We migrated to a new platform for the blog this year, and this got lost in the shuffle. Here it is, in PDF format, with a few revisions and updates:
